contract: No reviewed evidence means no score.

boundaries.title: Detect
boundaries.detail: Recognize YouTube, Goodreads, or an ordinary public page after a user action.
boundaries.privacy: URL and title stay in the browser.

boundaries.title: Canonicalize
boundaries.detail: Reduce the page to one stable source key and strip tracking parameters.
boundaries.privacy: Page text, cookies, and account data never enter the key.

boundaries.title: Resolve
boundaries.detail: Ask the public read-only API whether a matching analysis version exists.
boundaries.privacy: Only the canonical entity key is sent.

boundaries.title: Gate
boundaries.detail: Suppress scores until every eligible claim is reviewed and provenance is complete.
boundaries.privacy: Pending and partial work cannot leak a number.

boundaries.title: Show
boundaries.detail: Render a badge and a link to the versioned evidence trail, or a no-score state.
boundaries.privacy: Local metrics retain category counts, never page identity.
